responsibility: This machine-description support file defines the AArch64-specific RTL operand predicates and special predicates used by instruction recognition, expander matching, reload, and constraint-sensitive pattern selection. It centralizes tests for legal general-register, SIMD, SVE, immediate, addressing, compare, and memory-tagging operands—including many target-specific immediates and scalable-vector forms—so the AArch64 .md instruction patterns can share one precise set of acceptance rules for operands and operators.
